request.summary: Turn a photographed restaurant menu into a branded digital menu board with editable dishes and prices.
request.audience: Restaurant guests reading a dinner menu from shared signage.
request.primaryGoal: Preserve the restaurant's visual identity while keeping operational menu content editable as table rows.

assumptions: Menu sections contain different numbers of items and must paginate without leaving broken columns.
Temporarily unavailable dishes remain in the datasource and are hidden through an availability field.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The photographed menu identity must survive full-screen, wide-low, portrait, and compact restaurant signage placements.

surfaces.purpose: Wide-low menu zone with reduced secondary copy.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom color scheme.
Custom accent color for labels on light surfaces.
Message when no menu rows are available.
Selects Off, Subtle, or Expressive page transitions.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, keep one line and ellipsize the remaining tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The restaurant name is the primary brand signal and should adapt before the masthead composition is compressed.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize the dish name after reserving the price and leader line; keep the full value in the editable datasource.
dynamicText.rationale: Single-line dish and price registration preserves menu scan rhythm across uneven sections and rotating pages.

states.expectation: The coordinated light preset preserves the reference-led editorial menu identity.
Representative menu content remains visible before binding.
An explicit empty menu message replaces missing dishes.
A null bound datasource remains stable and does not substitute sample rows.
Long section, dish, description, and badge text remains contained.
Processed row-array output normalizes to the same menu model.
Uneven section counts and the final partial page remain balanced.
Edited dish names and prices update without rebuilding the app.
Menu pagination remains functional with page transition animation disabled.

behaviors.expectation: Different item counts per section rotate on schedule into balanced, non-overlapping menu pages with an optional bounded transition.
Datasource edits update placed menu content immediately.

visualDirection.summary: Translate the supplied Cordo menu photograph into a digital editorial system while preserving its recognizable restaurant character.
signatureChoices: Course sections keep the source menu's editorial rhythm rather than becoming dashboard cards.
Restaurant name, edition copy, and menu typography establish the venue before operational metadata.
avoid: Replacing the photographed identity with the boilerplate example palette.

visualReview.intent: A polished editorial restaurant menu that feels branded, legible, and intentionally composed rather than template-like.
focus: Verify unequal section lengths and final pages do not produce broken columns or excessive empty space.
Verify typography remains proportional and dish prices never collide with long names.
